translations.web: But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;
translations.bsb: However, in the cities of the nations that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, you must not leave alive anything that breathes.
translations.kjv: But of the cities of these people, which the LORD thy God doth give thee for an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth:
